recipe.name: Lanterna / investment / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Sacrificial investment pattern, sprued at the palm. The octagon, the lantern, its vault, the piers, spirelets and knops cast in place with the collets; cut the bearings to the measured stones, set the citrine pears point up in the lantern's eight windows and the amethyst on the boss, and open the amethyst's pilot. Polish the ribs, the pier faces, the spirelets and the knops.

Draw the lantern on the table, square to its sides
Raise the lantern off the table
Draw the lantern's hollow inside its walls, under the head
Hollow the lantern and open it down to the finger
Draw the base course round the lantern's foot
Raise the base course, weathered
Draw the rim moulding round the roof
Raise the rim moulding
Draw the boss at the vault's crown
Raise the boss
Draw the amethyst's collet on the boss, its bore the stone's cut-corner square
Raise the amethyst's collet off the boss
Turn the roll moulding round the boss's foot
Draw a rib's half-round section at the boss, square to the first corner
Run the rib out to the corner
Draw the first bay's right tierceron's section at its rib, square to the star's point
Run the right tierceron out to the star's point
Draw the first bay's left tierceron's section at its rib, square to the star's point
Run the left tierceron out to the star's point
Spring the star vault's ribs and tiercerons in every bay
Draw the first bay's light inside the star's point
Pierce the light through the roof
Pierce a light in every bay of the vault
Draw two lancets on the wall that faces along the finger

Raise the oculus's collet off the wall

Draw a pier on the lantern's first corner, its arrises chamfered
Raise the pier's lower stage

Raise the shaft past the roof
Twist the spirelet up off the shaft, tapering to its top
Stand a pinnacle on every corner
Lay a plane under the band's mid-plane
